authority: Explanatory metadata only; existing definitions remain authoritative.

entries.title: G16-01: Export topology and identity
entries.purpose: Checks whether the assessed export is bound to the candidate and accepted by the recorded topology checks.
entries.limit: A valid mesh shell does not prove a valid B-rep solid. Geometry identity, unit interpretation and mass agreement require their own evidence.

entries.title: G16-02: Geometry and holder compatibility
entries.purpose: Summarizes representation and holder compatibility observations used by the existing evaluator.
entries.limit: Envelope and retention proxies are not measured fit, comfort or retention in use.

entries.title: G16-03: Shape and archetype
entries.purpose: Checks conformity with the represented shape family.
entries.limit: A shape-family label does not validate a use case, human fit or structural reliability.

entries.title: G16-04: Reference-shape comparison
entries.purpose: Compares decoded geometry with the existing reference and recorded feature checks.
entries.limit: Automated reference similarity is not human aesthetic approval or an ergonomic experiment.

entries.title: G16-05: Lateral-response comparison
entries.purpose: Compares the retained plate lateral-response observation with one legacy requirement.
entries.limit: The historical use-case name does not establish a validated operational load. Shares an observation with the next predicate.

entries.title: G16-06: Additional lateral comparison
entries.purpose: Applies a second legacy comparison to the same lateral-response family.
entries.limit: Two thresholds on one response are not two independent experiments.

entries.title: G16-07: Refined lateral observation
entries.purpose: Reads the refined-discretization lateral observation.
entries.limit: Smaller elements alone do not establish convergence or model validity.

entries.title: G16-08: Ring-traction response
entries.purpose: Records the existing static ring-traction comparison.
entries.limit: A static model result is not a physical proof test or human-injury prediction.

entries.title: G16-09: Body-region torsion
entries.purpose: Reads the body-region observable from the existing torsion model.
entries.limit: Regional boundaries, stress recovery and model identity affect the observable.

entries.title: G16-10: Local plate torsion
entries.purpose: Reads the local region of the existing plate torsion model.
entries.limit: A plate observable does not establish local three-dimensional stress or fracture.

entries.title: G16-11: Refined local torsion
entries.purpose: Records the refined local plate observation.
entries.limit: Do not substitute the coarse or whole-body field when this observation is missing.

entries.title: G16-12: Local quadratic solid result
entries.purpose: Reads the quadratic tetrahedral local-solid model result.
entries.limit: Local-model boundary assumptions and stress recovery remain distinct from whole-part physical validation.

entries.title: G16-13: Support and stability
entries.purpose: Reports the alternate compliant-support model and its linear stability observation.
entries.limit: Linear eigenvalues and idealized support do not establish postbuckling behavior or calibrated hand contact.

entries.title: G16-14: Regional yield-order proxy
entries.purpose: Compares regional elastic response limits in the recorded model.
entries.limit: An elastic yield-order proxy is not a demonstrated fracture sequence or injury criterion.

entries.title: G16-15: Mesh and observable consistency
entries.purpose: Checks whether mesh sequence and observable identity support the stated convergence comparison.
entries.limit: Valid metadata does not alone admit an asymptotic discretization-error estimate.

entries.title: G16-16: Separate-solver consistency
entries.purpose: Compares separately attributed solver outputs for the matched discretized problem.
entries.limit: Solvers sharing geometry, boundary conditions or constitutive assumptions can agree and share error.

entries.title: RSV2-01: Shape and geometry
entries.purpose: Combines existing shape and geometric observations.
entries.limit: Overlaps G16-02 through G16-04; neither comfort nor aesthetic approval is measured.

entries.title: RSV2-02: Combined numerical response
entries.purpose: Combines the existing response comparisons under the recorded material envelope.
entries.limit: Shares plate observations with legacy diagnostics; not a separate solve for each Boolean.

entries.title: RSV2-03: Body and local torsion
entries.purpose: Groups body and refined local torsion comparisons.
entries.limit: Must preserve the two regional observables and their source identities.

entries.title: RSV2-04: Local solid response
entries.purpose: Groups the local-solid comparison.
entries.limit: Completeness, verification and favorable finding are separate facts.

entries.title: RSV2-05: Refined lateral response
entries.purpose: Groups the refined lateral comparison.
entries.limit: Reuses G16-07; does not add an independent experiment.

entries.title: RSV2-06: Regional yield order
entries.purpose: Groups the recorded sequence comparison.
entries.limit: Reuses G16-14 and its elastic-model limitations.

entries.title: RSV2-07: Additional response and geometry
entries.purpose: Collects additional response and geometry checks defined in the existing requirement implementation.
entries.limit: The name is a legacy label, not a validated bound on human behavior or safety.

entries.title: RSV2-08: Fatigue-model assessment
entries.purpose: Groups the existing fatigue-model comparison.
entries.limit: Mean-stress and material assumptions require process and surface evidence; no service-life experiment is established.

entries.title: RSV2-09: Exported edge measurements
entries.purpose: Checks recorded exported-geometry features.
entries.limit: Geometry measurements do not establish cutting effectiveness or material durability.

entries.title: RSV2-10: Exported point-profile measurements
entries.purpose: Checks the exported local profile and its recorded monotonicity.
entries.limit: A nominal profile is distinct from manufactured dimensions, metrology and physical performance.

entries.title: Analytic software controls
entries.purpose: References shared analytic/reference controls.
entries.limit: Repeated per-subject rows do not establish independent executions.

entries.title: Convergence arithmetic controls
entries.purpose: References checks of convergence arithmetic and refusal behavior.
entries.limit: A tested formula does not mean this candidate has a converged solution.

entries.title: Claim-handling controls
entries.purpose: References reporting and evidence-admission controls.
entries.limit: A software result does not certify candidate mechanics or physical safety.

entries.title: Separate-solver capability
entries.purpose: References retained solver-comparison capability evidence.
entries.limit: Shared evidence is not a fresh candidate-specific cross-check.

entries.title: Export units
entries.purpose: Records whether export unit identity is established.
entries.limit: All 23 historical cells are blocked; do not infer units from a plausible size.

entries.title: Solid topology
entries.purpose: Records whether the relevant single-solid topology is established.
entries.limit: All 23 historical cells are blocked; a current implementation does not repair an old missing receipt.

entries.title: Mass observation
entries.purpose: Records retained mass availability.
entries.limit: The 19 genome entries use plate/certification mass, not a STEP-versus-raster consistency test.

entries.title: Geometry identity
entries.purpose: Records binding of the observation to the intended CAD.
entries.limit: All 23 historical cells are blocked; filenames alone cannot establish identity.

entries.title: Plate response
entries.purpose: Reports the stored plate-response comparison.
entries.limit: Historical results retain their original model and source scope.

entries.title: Sequence proxy
entries.purpose: Reports the retained regional yield-order comparison.
entries.limit: An elastic ratio does not establish actual fracture or injury sequence.

entries.title: Fatigue screen
entries.purpose: Reports the existing fatigue-screen assessment.
entries.limit: Not a measured lifetime; material, surface, spectrum and uncertainty assumptions remain.

entries.title: Candidate mesh study
entries.purpose: Reports the stored convergence-evidence finding.
entries.limit: Observable and mesh identity must match; plateau or metadata success is not automatic convergence.

entries.title: Legacy side-report record A1
entries.purpose: References the common retained side report.
entries.limit: No distinct executed test or separate observable is established by this row.

entries.title: Legacy side-report record A2
entries.purpose: References the common retained side report.
entries.limit: No distinct executed test or separate observable is established by this row.

entries.title: Legacy side-report record A3
entries.purpose: References the common retained side report.
entries.limit: No distinct executed test or separate observable is established by this row.

entries.title: Support and stability report
entries.purpose: Records the alternate-support and stability report.
entries.limit: A complete report does not calibrate support assumptions against human contact.

entries.title: Solid-result completeness
entries.purpose: Reports whether the retained solid-result record is complete.
entries.limit: The 20 stored passes mean complete records, not 20 favorable strength findings.

entries.title: Grouped requirement finding
entries.purpose: Reports the combined historical grouped requirement outcome.
entries.limit: Nineteen failures and four blocked records are not 23 completed failures.
